# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | yellow |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | blue | yellow | red |
| 7 | red | blue | yellow |
| 8 | yellow | red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have only the manual, so I’m establishing a compact visual code for Deaf: four distinct gestures will represent the colors in the order blue, green, yellow, red. I’ll then transmit each display row as its three corresponding outputs. Deaf can compare the bomb’s visible display and light against this table and tell Blind the required color.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "🤘", "🤙", "🤞"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "👋", "🤟", "🤙", "🤞"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "👋", "🤞", "🤟", "🤙"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "👋", "🤙", "🤞", "🤟"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | yellow |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | blue | yellow | red |
| 7 | red | blue | yellow |
| 8 | yellow | red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please state the complete manual rule and establish a precise gesture code for reporting wire colours and markings to me. Ask Deaf to report positions 1, 2, and 3 in that code.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb facts: display is 8. Light is green. Wires from top to bottom are 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Apply the manual and tell the Blind the required action.

The manual gives the required colour from the display and light: display 8 with green light requires red. I’m using the same four-symbol colour code as before—blue, green, yellow, red—and sending Deaf the wire colours in order as well as the required red action. Deaf can then state everything aloud to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "🤘", "🤙", "🤞"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤞", "👏", "🤙", "👏", "🤟"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤞"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | yellow |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | blue | yellow | red |
| 7 | red | blue | yellow |
| 8 | yellow | red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No message reached me. Establish one compact code now: speak the code and manual rule to me, and gesture the identical code to Deaf. Then have Deaf report wire positions 1, 2, and 3 using that code.
Deaf says to Mute: Please state the manual's exact required action aloud to Blind now. Do not rely on gestures.

I cannot speak directly to Blind. I will therefore give Deaf the color code and the complete table in gestures, followed by the three wire colors and the required action. The established code is blue, green, yellow, red as 🤟, 🤘, 🤙, 🤞; 👋 separates entries. For display 8 with green light, the required action is red, and the wires are red, yellow, blue.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "🤘", "🤙", "🤞"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "👋", "🤟", "👋", "🤟", "👋", "🤘", "👋", "🤙", "👋", "🤙", "👋", "🤞", "👋", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "👋", "🤟", "👋", "🤞", "👋", "🤘", "👋", "🤙", "👋", "🤙", "👋", "🤟", "👋", "🤞", "👋", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "✊", "👋", "🤟", "👋", "🤙", "👋", "🤘", "👋", "🤙", "👋", "🤞", "👋", "🤘", "👋", "🤟", "👋", "🤞", "👋", "🤙"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤞", "👋", "🤙", "👋", "🤟"])
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤞"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | yellow |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | blue | yellow | red |
| 7 | red | blue | yellow |
| 8 | yellow | red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Bomb facts: display 8; light green; wires top to bottom are position 1 red, position 2 yellow, position 3 blue. Apply the manual and state exactly which wire position I must cut, or state that no cut is safe.
Deaf says to Mute: Your gestures cannot give Blind an actionable instruction. Speak the exact manual procedure aloud to Blind, including which wire or control to use.

The manual requires red for display 8 with green light. Wire 1 is red, so the safe action is to cut wire position 1. I cannot speak, so I’m sending Deaf a compact explicit code: 👍 means position 1, and 🤞 means red; their sequence means “cut position 1, the red wire.” Deaf must state that procedure aloud to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "🤞"])
```

| display \ light | blue | green | yellow |

| 4 | blue | yellow | red |
| 7 | red | blue | yellow |
| 8 | yellow | red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still have not received your manual instruction. Please send only the exact safe wire position for display 8, green light, and wires red/yellow/blue, or explicitly say no action.
Deaf says to Mute: I cannot hear you. Please speak the exact manual instruction clearly to Blind; Blind must use that instruction to act.

The required color is red, and the red wire is position 1. I cannot speak to Blind; Deaf can see gestures and must voice the instruction. The previously established position code uses 👍 for position 1.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | yellow |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | blue | yellow | red |
| 7 | red | blue | yellow |
| 8 | yellow | red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Urgent: on your next turn, speak the exact manual instruction directly to Blind. Facts remain display 8, green light, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue.
Deaf says to Mute: Tell Blind the exact manual instruction by voice now, including the precise wire or control and the required action.

I cannot speak, and Deaf cannot hear me, so I cannot directly voice the instruction to Blind. The manual maps display 8 with green light to red; among the wires, red is position 1. I will send Deaf the established position-one and red-code gestures so Deaf can say: cut wire 1.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "🤞"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | yellow |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | blue | yellow | red |
| 7 | red | blue | yellow |
| 8 | yellow | red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have still received no manual instruction. Please state the exact safe action now for display 8, green light, and wires position 1 red, position 2 yellow, position 3 blue. I will not cut without it.
Deaf says to Mute: The bomb remains display 8, green, with wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue. Give Blind the exact manual instruction by speech, including the precise action.

The safe manual result is red, and red is wire position 1. I cannot produce speech, so Deaf must convert the gesture into the required voice instruction for Blind during Deaf’s turn. The established position code is 👍 for position 1.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| display \ light | blue | green | yellow |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | blue | yellow | red |
| 7 | red | blue | yellow |
| 8 | yellow | red | blue |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please send the exact manual result for display 8, green light, and wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 blue: either cut position 1, cut position 2, cut position 3, or do not cut.
Deaf says to Mute: I see your thumbs-up, but it does not identify the required action. Speak the exact manual instruction to Blind, including the precise wire or control.

The manual result is red, and the red wire is position 1. Since I cannot speak, I’ll send Deaf a two-part gesture instruction: 👌 means cut, followed by 👍 for position 1. Deaf should voice “Cut wire position 1” to Blind.

```code
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👌", "👍"])
```
